title: Prohibition - OverSimplified
beats: Absurd breakfast skit sets the premise: Americans drank constantly
What is the most American thing? Answer: alcohol
Evidence drinking was normal (Washington, doctors, work) as office skit
Women as the first opposition; saloon speech skit
Women's crusade: praying, WCTU, school textbooks
Carrie Nation hatchet raids; why women's movement faded (sewing skit 6:12)
Anti-Saloon League: Wheeler tailors fear to each group (Paddy demo 7:31)
WWI anti-German sentiment; income tax replaces alcohol revenue 9:59
Americans try water, knitting, kites, then go buy illegal beer
Loopholes; Kazaa/Blockbuster analogy: unenforced law is not a law 15:01
Enforcement math: one agent per 70,666 Americans
Moonshine, Rum Row, bootleggers, corruption, Remus case
Hoover and Miles, 'blame the Democrats', report skit
Sabin women's repeal movement; Valentine's Massacre; Capone jailed on taxes
What did we learn? Maybe nothing; ends 'dumb stinky idiots'

metrics.misconception: yes: premise that banning drink would fix society; shown failing 11:18-12:06 and 13:12-
metrics.examples: many one-off anecdotes; rising stakes from skits to gangsters; Hoover/Miles skit repeats 3 times (26:34, 28:41, 31:02)
metrics.ending: Mock-moral and shrug: Americans do what you forbid, or no lesson (33:01)

principles.1: confirmed: breakfast skit and 'most American thing' 0:15-1:05; Kazaa piracy analogy 15:01
principles.2: confirmed: almost no jargon; names given with a role (Wheeler pressure group)
principles.4: partly: Kazaa analogy 15:01 starts from home but no rigor step
principles.5: confirmed: nearly every point acted as a skit (Paddy 7:31, water/knitting 11:34, Hoover 26:34)
principles.7: partly: the water/knitting/kites attempts 11:34 let viewer predict the bootleg turn; otherwise told
principles.8: partly: speech steady; idea rate quickens with stories, slows only for loophole list 13:44-15:01
principles.9: partly: running gag repeats (Hoover/Miles x3, 'Release the lions', 'You know em, you love em, women' 2:07 and 27:05)
principles.10: contradicted: starts big, no tiny-to-big ladder
principles.11: partly: temperance, then ASL, then law, then failure, then repeal is chronological and causal
principles.12: confirmed: connects to Napster/Kazaa, Depression, WWI, income tax 9:59
principles.13: partly: jokes carry content; expert detail (Wheeler, income tax swap) with no tool-choice rationale

new_moves.name: callback-gag-as-structure
new_moves.what: Recurring skit (Hoover/Miles) re-enters at each turning point, doubling as a status check on the plot

new_moves.name: tailor-the-pitch-demo
new_moves.what: Show the same fact repackaged for each audience to explain coalition-building

new_moves.name: shrug-ending
new_moves.what: Offer two moral candidates then undercut them

theory: Each abstract mechanism (pressure politics, unenforceable law) is dramatized as a short character skit, then named in one sentence. Recurring gags and a ranked cause chain keep a 33-minute narrative navigable; the personal analogy (piracy) is the one place the viewer is made to feel the abstraction.
velocity: Scene builder: allow a persistent running-character that re-enters at turning points
Voice: sponsor-style interruptions are admin beats; tag and skip in learner model
Orchestrator: reserve a 'you already did this' analogy from learner's own experience (piracy-style) before stating the principle
Evals: count how many abstract claims get an enacted example within 30 s
quote: Or maybe there is no lesson.
